payload.body: Epic complete. Delivered: FR-78/79 control plane + MediaPlaneAdapter, FR-80 client call helpers (TS/Swift/Android), FR-81 self-built P2P WebRTC (coturn-REST TURN, browser-free-testable driver), FR-82 presence, FR-83 single-box embedded mediasoup SFU (native dep isolated), FR-84 call UI (web/iOS/Android), FR-85 E2EE design + key-epoch seam, FR-154 bus-coordinated multi-box SFU placement, FR-155 web SFU produce/consume client driver. Future hardening tracked as FR-156 (production SFrame). All merged green.
